title: Whispers and Game Master tools
text:
Private messages, PvP gear upgrades with Honor and Conquest, and a clean slate when you die.

✨ Whispers: right-click a player's portrait and choose Whisper, or type /w name message. /r message replies to the last person who whispered you. Only the person you whisper can read it
• PvP gear is upgraded at the forge with PvP currency instead of gold and ore: Emberguard gear costs Honor (30 for the first star, rising by 15 per star) and Ashen Champion's gear costs Conquest (20, rising by 10)
• The Bloodsand Chest now appears every 30 minutes, so each one is worth fighting over
🔧 Dying now clears every effect on you: poisons and bleeds, heals over time, shields, buffs such as shouts and evasion, roots and stealth. Combo points reset too
🔧 A Shade's poison stops the moment its target dies, so you no longer keep bleeding after you respawn, and the Shade's combo points reset when their target dies
✨ Game Master tools: /give gives any item to any player (or yourself), /spawn summons any boss in front of you (/despawn removes it), /summon pulls players to you, and /tpplayer sends a player anywhere
